topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes for cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the learning objectives regarding the functional hallmarks of cancer and their underlying mutations.

topics.label: Growth signal autonomy and proliferative signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how mutations in signaling cascades such as Wnt/beta-catenin and receptor tyrosine kinases drive independent growth and survival.

topics.label: Block to terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how differentiation arrest prevents cells from exiting the cell cycle across hematopoietic malignancies and intestinal carcinomas.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis via p53 and Bcl-2 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how cancer cells resist programmed cell death through alterations in p53 and the balance of pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence bypass, and stress responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanics of telomere shortening, the bypass of cellular senescence, and the role of p53 in mediating cellular stress responses before summarizing growth control hallmarks.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the metabolic alterations in cancer cells, including aerobic glycolysis, tissue-of-origin metabolic profiles, and Krebs cycle mutations generating oncometabolites.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and vascularization
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic covers the necessity, timing, and molecular balance of blood vessel recruitment to sustain tumor growth.

topics.label: Mechanisms, monitoring, and genetics of invasion and metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the metastatic cascade, liquid biopsy monitoring of circulating tumor cells, the seed-and-soil hypothesis, and genomic features of metastatic clones.

topics.label: Concluding summary on cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with final framing on hallmark integration and closing logistical remarks.
